description: This file defines internal interfaces related to canceling grain calls within Orleans runtime, including the IGrainCallCancellationExtension interface for cancel requests, the IGrainCallCancellationManager interface for managing cancellations, and an implementation class ExternalClientGrainCallCancellationManager.

classes.name: ExternalClientGrainCallCancellationManager
classes.description: Implementation of IGrainCallCancellationManager that signals cancellation requests to grain call extensions.

methods.name: CancelRequestAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously requests cancellation of a grain call within IGrainCallCancellationExtension.

methods.name: SignalCancellation
methods.description: Attempts to cancel a grain call by invoking CancelRequestAsync on the target grain extension.
